name: lesson-roll
title: Lesson roll
for_each: select id,code from sessions order by on_date

sections.title: Lesson
sections.sql: select s.code,s.on_date,s.starts_at,c.name class,i.name instructor from sessions s join classes c on c.id=s.class_id join instructors i on i.id=c.instructor_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Students
sections.sql: select r.student_code,r.student,r.booking,coalesce(a.status,'unmarked') attendance from lesson_roster r left join attendance a on a.student_id=r.student_id and a.session_id=r.session_id where r.session_id=$1 order by r.student

name: family-statement
title: Family fee statement
for_each: select id,code from families order by code

sections.title: Family
sections.sql: select name,email,phone from families where id=$1

sections.title: Charges and balances
sections.sql: select code,description,due_on,currency,amount_cents,balance_cents from fee_balances where family_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: Currency is shown per charge. This statement does not request or collect a payment.

sections.title: Recorded receipts
sections.sql: select r.reference,r.received_on,f.currency,r.amount_cents from receipts r join fees f on f.id=r.fee_id where f.family_id=$1 order by r.received_on

name: progress-report
title: Student progress report
for_each: select id,code from students order by code

sections.title: Current level
sections.sql: select name,level,required,passed,last_assessed from skill_progress where id=$1

sections.title: Assessment history
sections.sql: select sk.name skill,a.on_date,a.passed,a.note from assessments a join skills sk on sk.id=a.skill_id where student_id=$1 order by a.on_date,sk.code
sections.note: An instructor decides readiness. This is not a swimming qualification.

name: makeup-letter
title: Make-up lesson credit
for_each: select id,code from makeups order by code

sections.title: Credit details
sections.note: Draft for staff review. A place is confirmed only after a booking is recorded.
